zh.title: 输入框上方更干净
zh.description: 状态文字都去掉了，只保留需要你当场处理的卡片

zh.title: 停止后可以接着做
zh.description: 停止或预算用完后，发一句“继续”就能接上；预算触顶可直接提高

zh.title: 侧栏状态更准确
zh.description: 进行中只显示转圈，后台完成的待看状态重启后也能恢复

zh.title: 拉伸窗口不再上下跳
zh.description: 输出时调整窗口大小，内容保持稳定

zh.title: 更新说明一屏看完
zh.description: 不用再一页页点“下一步”

zh.title: 错误信息完整显示
zh.description: 错误卡的摘要不再被裁切

en.title: A cleaner composer
en.description: Status text is gone from above the input. Only cards that need your action stay

en.title: Continue after stopping
en.description: After a stop or a budget limit, send “continue” to pick up where you left off. You can raise the budget right there

en.title: More accurate sidebar
en.description: Running sessions just show a spinner, and finished background sessions stay marked after a restart

en.title: Steadier window resizing
en.description: Content stays put when you resize the window during a reply

en.title: Release notes on one screen
en.description: No more clicking Next through each page

en.title: Full error details
en.description: Error card summaries are no longer cut off
